description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans silos, specifically testing scenarios involving ungraceful silo shutdowns and their impact on outstanding grain requests. It includes a test class 'SilosStopTests' with methods configuring test clusters and testing silo failures.

classes.name: SilosStopTests
classes.description: A test class verifying silo ungraceful shutdown handling and its effects on grain requests in Orleans.

classes.name: BuilderConfigurator
classes.description: A nested configurator class implementing ISiloConfigurator and IClientBuilderConfigurator to set options for silos and clients during testing.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures silo options like missed probes and timeout durations and sets clustering assumptions for testing.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures clientBuilder to connect to a static cluster using a specified IP endpoint.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Overrides cluster configuration to include custom configurators for silos and clients.

methods.name: SiloUngracefulShutdown_OutstandingRequestsBreak
methods.description: Test method that kills a secondary silo during a long-running request to verify proper exception handling.

methods.name: GetGrainOnTargetSilo
methods.description: Helper method to obtain a grain located on a specific silo, with retry logic based on runtime instance ID.
